{"content": "Title: Fresh Ideas Tracker

Purpose:
This document serves as a central repository for capturing and tracking innovative concepts and suggestions.

Structure:
1. Idea ID
2. Title
3. Description
4. Category
5. Owner
6. Status (New/Under Review/In Progress/Implemented)
7. Notes

Instructions:
- Add a new entry whenever a fresh idea is generated.
- Update the status as the idea progresses.
- Use consistent formatting for easy sorting and filtering.

Example Entry:
ID: 001
Title: Eco-friendly Packaging
Description: Replace plastic packaging with biodegradable alternatives.
Category: Sustainability
Owner: Jane Doe
Status: Under Review
Notes: Initial feasibility study pending.
", "file_name": "FreshIdeas.txt"}
